facts.fact: The report states that in July 2025 TTCL and Kenya's ICTA launched and implemented a terrestrial fibre link connecting Dar es Salaam to Mombasa.
facts.system: TTCL-ICTA Dar es Salaam-Mombasa terrestrial fibre link

facts.fact: The report states that in May 2025 Bayobab completed a fibre optic network linking Mombasa in Kenya to Kampala in Uganda.

systems.system: TTCL-ICTA Dar es Salaam-Mombasa terrestrial fibre link

note: Horizon Fiber joins Djibouti, Ethiopia and Sudan and does not name Kenya; the Kenyan links are background mentions.
